Hi! My name is Joshua Clive, for introduction I am a high school student with comparatively superior intellectual capabilities and an infatuation towards technological topics, thus making me an enigma for the society. Consequently, you may not see me on TV, or on stage, or in the court, or perhaps anywhere but fathom that I am here, within this framework, working for something far more than myself ……………. “Dude! Your making a profile for a dating site, not a character in a RPG.” said Spencer.

“Well the girls don’t dig nerd plus geek combo!! I have to make it sound cooler somehow”. I replied.

“Why not just type in the truth and what if someone does show up.”

“Dude! Even those single moms in the pop ups don’t show up for you”. Spencer chuckles.

“Ohh haha like you get laid every day”. I remarked.

“C’mon man why ya taking this so seriously, it’s just prom”.

“Well it’s the only chance I have for not being a loner in high school; I missed the previous one and its my second last year now. I just don’t wanna go to college being a …….”

“Loser”. Spencer added.

“Yeah”. I sighed.

“Just post this anyway and keep your fingers crossed “.

“Yep, and we better get going before Professor Oak realizes we’ve been using his Tinder account.”

“Yeah, see ya tomorrow.”

So we left for our homes, and what happened the day after changed my life.

It was Thursday morning, woke up went to school as usual. After Calculus class I headed straight to the computer club. Just before I entered the lab HE showed up.

“Hey Josh slaying those motherboards.”

(Not this guy again)” Hey! Drake how’s it going?” (don’t know why I asked that)

Drake is basically the “Cool” kid, He’s in the basketball team and is quite popular among the girl’s cause…. well I don’t get the cause part.

“Awesome, quite awesome, was just going to ask Margo out for the prom”. He boasted.

Well Margo is like the most popular girl in high school and you can guess why…

“So what up with you, coming to prom this time.” He added.

“Yeah…. Ummmm…. about that…”

“He’s going” interrupted Spencer.

“What??” Me and Drake spontaneously.

“uhhhhh…I mean yeah sure I am”. I said clueless.

“He even has a date.” Spencer continued.

I shrugged my shoulders “What?????”

Spencer waved, probably telling me he got this.

“Ohhh who is it Josh?”. Asked Drake laughingly.

“You’ll find out”. Spencer dashed in.

“Well, be sure to introduce her to me”. And he left grinning.

Immediately I hit Spencer on the head.

“What’s wrong with you? Now he’s gonna brag when I don’t show up.”

“Don’t worry. I wasn’t lying”. Spencer replied.

“What? wait did someone respond to the Tinder ID?”

“No. But I can get you a date.”

“How”?

“Well, meet Smith”. Spencer proclaimed holding up his phone to me to show a picture.

“Dude, you do realize this is a guy right”?

“Yeah, so”?

“Well, in case you forgot I’m not gay!!” I yelled angrily.

“Woah! I don’t mean that, see this guy he’s known for hooking up people, they say he’s a master”.

“So ya saying I go hire him”?

“Well it’s worth a shot”.

So, later that afternoon we went to meet this Smith guy. Apparently, he used to sit underneath a tree in the parking lot. He was a well-built guy, wore a hoodie and stood in a very promising pose. We went up to him; he was sleeping under the shade.

“Are you Smith?” I asked.

“Yeah…” Smith replied in a drowsy voice.

“Well we just wanted to ask….”

“You come here to seek knowledge”, Interrupting us.

“Nahhh we just came here to ask if you could hook us up a girl”. Answered Spencer.

“That my friend is knowledge, it’s no skill, no talent simply knowledge”. Smith added.

Both of us gave a weird look at each other.

“Hey! I just want a date for prom, can ya please help me out?” I asked.

“Yeah man but my services come with money.”

“How much”?

“50$”

“FIFTY BUCKS!!” we said jumping up. Smith nodded.

“Take it or leave it boys”.

At that time, I was desperate, all I could think about was this last chance, also that Drake idiot, but this was my only shot at an actual date.

“I’ll take it”. I said.

“Pleasure doing business with ya”, He said triumphantly.

“Okay, so now what?”

“Now before we go into action phase I need to ask a few questions”. Smith exclaimed.

“Like”?

“Well for starters who do you want to go out with?”

I couldn’t think of any girl so I went with the first one that came up in my mind.

“Margo!”

“What “?? Said Spencer. “At least go with someone possible”.

“That’s 10$ more to the bill”. Added Smith.

“Wait why”? I inquired.

“Have ya seen the girl, more importantly have ya seen yourself”.

“He has a point”. Spencer shrugged.

I hit Spencer on the shoulder, “Well I am desperate, any other question”?

“Do ya have something that might help?” Smith asked.

“Well we used to be friends back in middle school”.

“He’s asking for something that actually happened and not in your fantasies”. Barged in Spencer.

“Hey! It’s true we were neighbors and she was a good friend”.

“What happened then?”

“High school”. I answered.

“Anyways seeing your current stature, you ain’t gonna get Margo as a date for prom or in fact anyone”. Came in Smith.

“So …”.

“Well seeing the difficulty of the task the regular approach may not succeed, The Talent technique may not work either, and musical impression may have little chance…..” Continued Smith.

“Who’s he talking to?” I asked Spencer.

“You sure we got the right guy”? Spencer asked.

“How am I supposed to know, you told me about him”.

“Yeah not a good idea”.

“I have it”. Smith yelled suddenly. “The Damsel in Distress!!”

“The what”? Spencer interrupted.

“Are you Okay if the client is covered in blood”? He asked me.

“You’re gonna kill her!!”.

“No, just cover her in blood”.

“What? That’s even worse” I exclaimed.

“What are you a maniac”. Spencer came in.

“Don’t worry I’m not gonna hurt her”. Assured Smith.

“That’s what every guy in the horror film says”. Spencer said.

“Shut up Dispenser”. Smith cutting us off.

“It’s Spencer”. Corrected Spencer.

“Same thing, now listen you hooligans, I’m not going to kill Margo”. Smith continued.

“Look she’s popular so she’s probably gonna end up the Queen of the Prom, she sits on stage and we have a bucket of blood above her chair, we spill that over her and it’s her special night so she’s devastated”.

“And how’s this helping me”?

“Well this is where you come in. She’s gonna go off crying to some corner everyone will be laughing at her except her old friend who comes in to support the Damsel in Distress”.

“Well we don’t know for sure if she’s gonna be Queen this year. The competitions tough”. Spencer told us.

“So we jack up the pooling booth, fill it with fake votes so she definitely wins”. Smith came in with the solution.

“You’re forgetting about the BLOOD, where are we gonna get that”. I intrigued.

“Butchers shop, they have troughs of it”. Answered Smith.

The plan as wacko as ever had a certain lure to it and I had to admit it could work. So later that day we went to the Butchers and it was sorta weird.

“You want what now”? asked the Butcher.

“Cows blood, two bags of it”. We replied awkwardly.

“What are you going to do with blood”?

“Trust me you don’t wanna know”.

While he was bagging the blood we overheard him saying:

“Kids these days, if they are kids in the first place friggin vampires”.

So now we had the blood, Smith brought in the bucket and we were all set up. All we needed now was to wait for the prom day.

Saturday came along, the theme of the prom was Casino Royale, everyone came up dressed quite formal. We were stalling in the crowd. Spencer set up the bucket way earlier, he attached a rope to it and set the line backstage so no one notices it. Smith gave us walkie talkies and we were communicating throughout the prom.

“HEY!! Josh”. A familiar voice appeared.

“Drake how’s it going, you here with Margo”?

“Ehhhh..no she kinda ….ehhh someone already asked her out so..”. Stammered Drake.

“Uhh so unfortunate”.

“So where’s your date”?

“You’ll see her soon enough”.

And that concluded our talk. The dance was about to end which meant time for the King Queen announcement. We took our places; Spencer went backstage to queue the rope. The host came to stage to give the cringiest speech in history and finally came to the big announcement.

“And the king of prom night 2018 is …….”

I don’t remember the guy’s name.

“The Queen of prom is………. Margo Rochester.”

I couldn’t believe the fake votes worked, even though we did put almost 100 votes in there but it still came in a surprise. Anyways, as per ritual the King and Queen took their places on stage and sat down on their made up thrones.

“Spencer, queue the blood”.

We had it planned that we’ll drop the bucket when they applaud for the king and queen.

“And ladies and gentleman, there before you are your King and Queen of Prom 2018, give them a big round of an applause” …….

And…………………baam!

Nothing happened. No bucket came down flying.

“HEY! Spencer that’s your queue”. Smith yelled in the walkie talkie.

“It’s stuck!”

“What do you mean it’s stuck”?

“I mean external force applied to the ‘in equilibrium body’ isn’t displacing it, it’s stuck man. It ain’t budging”.

“Yank it man, pull harder”. Smith ordered.

“Hurry up man! They’re about to get off stage.” I said worriedly.

“He’s not gonna make it”. Smith said and left my side pushing the crowd to get upfront. As he got near the stage he yelled:

“Run man that’s a vampire!”.

“Dude! Seriously this is high school no one falls for these sorta pranks”. Remarked the host.

“You think I’m kidding I saw one right there”. He said pointing towards the headlights.

“Man I don’t remember putting anything in the juice, what ya on man?”. Asked the Host.

And Smith was brilliantly delaying time. Then I took the walkie talkie and called Spencer.

“Bro, Don’t let me down here”.

“Dude, I’m trying my best, I’m seriously pulling it with all I got how much that bucket weighs man”.

“I don’t know just jerk it”.

“What?........Hey wait …. I see the problem; I was pulling the wrong rope”.

“Seriously! Man, Seriously!”.

“Sorry, my bad”.

On the other hand;

“You have to trust me man, I saw a vampire there you better run mate”. Smith trying hard to distract the host.

“Dude, first of all there isn’t a thing as vampire and don’t you think even if it existed we would’ve seen some sorta sign….”

And just then the bucket dropped blood all over the queen and king followed by screams from the crowd. The blood brought chaos in the room, everyone panicking and running here and there. Smith looked at me and gave me a nod.

Just as all this was happening I looked at Margo who left the stage and ran towards the balcony. That was my time, as I was going after her Smith caught up and put a headphone in my ear.

“Just repeat what I say”.

I nodded and made way to the balcony. There she stood, her dress now all covered in blood, her black hair wet and distorted, her face dripping with all the makeup falling down with her tears. To be honest I never saw a girl crying. I went up to her;

(“Bad night huh?” Smith on the earpiece)

“Bad night huh?”

Margo shook her head slightly,

(“You know you look like Pennywise with that makeup”)

“You know you look like Pennywise with that makeup”, I repeated.

Margo gave a slight smile.

(“Why so sullen”?)

“Why so sullen”?

“It’s…it’s just I thought tonight was my special night…. I got made Queen unexpectedly and you know this was my first time and it just kind of messed up in the end…. I guess everyone’s going to call me Bloody Marie from now on”. Margo said as wiped tears of her face.

“I don’t think so; it’s High School people aren’t kids”.

“It’s not just every time I expect something good’s gonna happen it just ends up a disaster……. back in Dramatics society I played Cinderella and got a certificate saying “Excellent performance” and I was really happy thinking the people saw my potential, turns out everyone who participated got one, even Ivan who just stood on stage because he was the tree……. Anyways it’s just every time”.

(“Now place your hand on her shoulder and repeat after me”)

I crept close to her, she had her face down on her hands, sobbing, I raised my hand slowly moving it towards her finally placing it on her shoulder and gave a slight pat.

(…. “Oh my God that’s a vulture size bug”) a screaming voice came from the headphone.

At first I kind of hesitated then thought the guy is quiet wacky so I should probably say that,

“Oh my God that’s a vulture size bug”!!

“Where”? Margo,

(“It’s on your butt don’t move”)

“Hmmmmm…it’s on your butt. Don’t move!”.

“Get rid of it!!”. Yelled Margo,

I waved my hand just above her behind.

(“Glad we got rid of that…. ohhh I almost forgot about Josh”)

(“………ohh wait, idiot you weren’t supposed to say that, the bug was on Spencer).

Apparently he saw that on Spencer but I didn’t know. At that moment I blushed so hard I went red.

(“Now say….hmm… well that was pretty awkward”)

“Well…that was pretty awkward”, I replied.

“Yeah….”, She blushed, she actually blushed. First time I’ve ever a girl shy and that too because of me.

(“Now wait for my signal..”)

We stood there on the ledge; both of us had our arms over the woodwork as we gazed on the light up city in total dark. Suddenly, a thing flew up right across our faces, went up and exploded.

“Fireworks.”, Margo said looking up.

(“Now; hand on shoulder”)

And before I could react to him, she snug herself into my arms.

(“I have to admit it man, even I’m a bit jealous”)

And we stood there, Margo in my arms, under the shimmering fireworks blooming into the endless night. We stared at the little suns fading in crimson shades. Changing night into day, a moment we both could see. We weren’t even doing anything, just stood there looking as the colors unfold. I took my coat and put it around us.

Somewhere between this moment, Drake showed up and saw us. I could swear he went off kicking the ground. We both stood there for the night, prom ended, Smith and Spencer went home, people left in dismay but we really didn’t care, just stood on the balcony. In the end, the whack job did get me the girl, the girl who I never thought would even speak to me was now cuddling in my arms. The fireworks stopped and we lay there through the night, a night that never seemed to end.

“Man you really do take your time getting ready” said spencer, “well man from today I’m not single anymore, gotta be careful how I look” I exclaimed as I took my bike out to head towards school.

The prom night was on Friday and it has been two days, I have not seen or talked to Margo but I’m really looking forward to it today, 2 months of school is still left until we move to the next and final year. Normally Monday’s are the days where any student would dread to go to school but I have been anxiously waiting for this Monday. Though I was not aware that all my excitement will get multiplied by 100 and be turned into a nightmare.

“What is this?” I asked as my eyes could not believe what they were seeing, “I have a bad feeling about this” spencer said as if he had figured what could be the cause of that, in front of us, on the main school wall it was written big in red ‘Margo the bloody cheating Bitch’.

Both of us were treading the school hallways looking at everyone with eyes that questioned WHY but with eyes that knew they were at fault. “I need to go see where Margo is” I said to spencer, “should I come”, not its fine” I said as I ran off to towards her classroom. Her class was the one right in front of ours, and when I entered I could not see her, my eyes chased her here and there until I saw Beth. I asked her whether she knew where Margo was, “you don’t know? Margo has been suspended from school on the charges for rigging the prom election for the queen, further details are being investigated and she is probably gonna be expelled”. Hearing this was the same as hearing the siren for doomsday. You see apparently Jenifer Hayes the rich school director’s daughter and the competition for Margo seemed pretty pissed at her loss when she was so sure she would win that she even got herself a custom design victory dress beforehand. Upon her loss she wanted to see how could she lose and they discovered that the box had 100 more votes than the total people who voted all in Margo’s vote. And this all got us to where we are now.

Joshua returned back to Spencer looking as pale as ever. “What should I do man, it’s my entire fault” I asked spencer. “There is another problem before I give you the answer to this question of yours, they are looking into the blood basket thing now too and have asked me to bring in Smith because apparently while he was stalling for us he got too much exposure and is the probable culprit and was seen with us. Sooo… well they want us to bring him in or we get suspended too.” I glanced at spencer and knew we were fucked up good this time. “This was a very childish plan to begin with, how could we have been so foolish?” “Love my friend” spencer said, “Love and friendship” I gave him a smile and put my arm around my childhood friend.

“The principal has given us a leave so we can find smith, let’s go” Spencer said as he got up and I followed suit. While on the way I asked if we were going to the exact place where we first met him, “Yeah he’s normally there” Spencer said. “How do you know” I asked. “Someone told me,” he looked pale while answering so I didn’t inquire further but I knew it that I will regret it later, and guess what? I did…

When we reached there we saw the tree but he was not there. “bro you realize he is not here right” “I do” Spencer replied in his cringy voice which he usually makes when he’s tense. “He won’t even pick up the call”. “You know where that leads us right, or do you want a geek to explain to you how the villains played the naïve boys.” I said, not caring anymore, for what I know … all was gone. “I won’t accept this…,” Spencer kept on disbelieving while I asked one thing, “Who told you about smith?” “It was…. OH NO” “Let me assume, it was” Both of them answered to each other simultaneously, “Jennifer Hayes”.

“Oye lets not jump to conclusions, maybe he’s just busy, and Jennifer had no grudge against us right, so let’s head back and ask her” Spencer said as we both quickly got on our way.

We reached school quicker on the way back, “Jennifer will be in the French class right about this time” spencer exclaimed, “My friend you sure seem to know a lot about her,” I gave him a smirk but he didn’t reply, then suddenly it hit me, “Oye isn’t French class right next to the headmaster’s office.” And spencer replied that which I wish were true too. “Let’s just hope he’s not in the office.”

We were about to enter the class but before we could make our move Mr.Oak came out from the headmasters office, and as soon as he saw us I got this feeling like we, the fish were caught in the net. “If it isnt Mr.Clive and Mr.William, would you mind accompany me to the principal’s office, he and the headmaster are waiting for you”

We were done, spencer caught a glimpse in the classroom, there were supposed to be 11 students but only 10 were present, Jennifer was not there. Mr.Oak took us to the principal’s office which is supposed to be a spacious room but for this once, it looked really crowded and small. My parents, spencer’s parents, Jennifer, Smith all were present, we were to be the cherry on the cake.

What happened in the office was too long and lost for me to be exact, because me and spencer were unable to accept this reality. Apparently Smith knew he was being searched for so he himself came to the office. Told the principal of his involvement. For some reason the way he explained all made him look so innocent and we were not even allowed to speak. The principal admiring his honesty and courage forgave him, he was not a student of our school to begin with so he already got an edge. In front of our parents we were branded as cheaters too. The story they thought was that we made a distraction via the blood and helped Margo cheat and win. When I spoke on Margo’s behalf my own dad slapped me. It was useless, we were demoted, with the finals on our head he banished us for the remaining year and now we had to repeat the class. Jennifer and smith walked away. Our parents walked on us, and we, me and my friend floated in the abyss of what just happened. Our life ahead was life in hell.

Still unable to grasp how fast everything went, me and spencer were sitting under a tree in front of the school gate. The news about us being culprits spread around fast thanks to Jennifer and her evil social accounts. After a while we saw a boy and a girl coming towards us, they were being so cheaply chummy in the public that it creeped me out. But when they came to us, our jaw dropped, it was Smith and Jennifer. “I’m sorry boys, you had to go through all of that due to us, I really am.” Smith said to us in a sorry tone. “What did we even do to you.” Spencer got angry and said that while standing up to their face, I still don’t know who he said that to, maybe both. “I gave you Smith’s contact on purpose so you can go and meet the love guru because I knew you guys were desperate on finding a dance partner for the prom, he was supposed to trick you in getting close to Margo but I never would have thought that the nerd was foolish enough to come to our trap all by himself. Well you made it easy for him, he made a plan where Margo’s night was ruined and we had to make sure she got expelled too, so I had to sacrifice my queen position for it, make you guys cheat, and let her win so I can create an issue, Oh so easy”. Jennifer explained to me how she played us. She was afraid of Margo’s gaining popularity that she got her kicked out. I got up and asked “She’s crazy, but why you Smith, you don’t seem like a bad guy, Why?” “I have my reasons of revenge; reasons you don’t have anything to do with you.” “Not having anything to do with us you say, you destroyed our high school lives.” Spencer broke in. “Your Pawns. We used you like ones and sacrificed you like ones too. To have our checkmate on Margo.” Jennifer said with menacing laughter. I never knew she was this wicked. So the movies and TV dramas are true in these regards. Characters like her do exist. Smith was a little sad when she called us pawns but he didn’t say anything, it felt as if he was helpless. After stating us pawns both of them left. Spencer stood there in anger glaring them, ready for revenge of his own. “Tell me you recorded all that on the mobile” I said, “I thought recording was the job of geeks” he said cooling down a bit, “My mobile is in the locker” I said, “Mine too” was his answer.

“Hey Are we really Pawns? “I asked. “I don’t know, but I do know that we surely acted like ones”. Unfortunately, he was true.

“Life can’t get any messier can it now” spencer said now in his ‘I don’t care anymore voice’ as he sat down and leaned against the tree but I was not able to follow suit, for I saw his answer coming towards us, it was Margo, she was red faced and looked angry as hell and well was probably coming to murder us. “Apparently Life can my friend …..”

*10 YEARS AGO*

Walton elementary school section, fourth standards, boys and girls around the age 10 were engaged in work. An age where the mind blossoms and finds its interests, an age where goals and future ambitions start to rise, all these different individuals, thinking and going over things they fancy, among these kids one of them had developed a strange liking to a topic not suited to his age and time. ‘The Feminine Gender’, “What goes on in the heads of girls and women, why do they act different, what could be the reason behind their code of actions ….”

Questions like these were common to flood Smith’s mind. He was extremely intrigued with the opposite sex though there was no malice in his mind, all he wanted was to know them better. For this purpose, he would study a lot, and sit and talk mostly with girls and be friends with them to know them better. All of the boys would make fun of him but no one ever hurt him and he never bothered, he was fine and talked to boys normally and even hung out with them from times, he had kept his life and interest balanced. Just like he was fascinated by how the feminine mind works, a girl in his class, Margarette Robby was intrigued with him, but only him for she knew his mind craves something different from other boys and hence had a liking to him. It was not surprising that they became friends soon enough and from friends to best friends. Time passed, their friendship grew stronger, and smith had apparently become a love guru in these 5 years that went by…

Middle school was about to end, and after elementary a lot had happened in the middle school, a time where the young teens get ready to embark either on the best or the worst time of their life. In the uprising of puberty and the trend of relations, Smith and Margarette were an official young couple, but everyone like them, everyone except one person. Unexpectedly that one person was Margo, Margarette’s younger sister.

Always planning to destroy the bond between these two, she would devise a lot of strategies, but none of them ever even got the chance to be even carried out. Smith and Margarette were unaware of her feelings for she always acted in front of them as if she’s really happy. It was these ending times where she finally got her chance.

Margo made a deal with her class fellow Drake. Drake was a popular boy, but he had a tough competition with a boy named Steve Harrington. ( It was this boy Steve who won the election of prom king with Margo in present time ) At that time, Steve was in a relation with Margo, in exchange for Drakes help promised to dump his rival in public on Valentine’s Day, this would hurt his reputation and that would mean plus points for the rival Drake. All Drake had to do was call smith who was his senior and a good senior who helped all the boys with matters that involved girls.

It was an ordinary night Smith came home with Margarette after school, both of them talked and after a while Margo joined in, “Hello Smith how are you?” “I’m good girl, what about you” smith replied, “I’m good and all but I really wished you were great with boy’s knowledge too like you are with girls.” “Wow, you like a boy; I thought you were already in a rela…” “I’m thinking of ending it.” “That’s sad.” and after a while Smith left. Margo’s plan was set in motion.

The next day Drake came to Smith, he had said he wanted to talk. “Hello Smith the guru” said Drake. “Cut the cheesy act, tell me to what do I owe the pleasure of the expected hot shot of middle school.” Smith replied in a chuckling voice. “You see smith I like a girl, and something happened” Drake said in a concerned voice. “Why do you make it sound like someone died” Smith was still laughing. “It’s Margo Smith.” Suddenly Smith got serious. Wait, wow, she. “So the boy she hinted me was Drake, that’s not good of Margo, running after popularity,” he thought to himself, but anyhow I hope she understands it herself. “So what happened?” “She told me to wait after the class, I did, and then she tried to kiss me, I think we are too young yet to start with the physical relations please tell me what to do I really like her too but I’m confused.” “MARGO WHAAT…” Smith said out in a loud voice. “Well boy listen starting a relation with a kiss is wrong but no age is small or big for anything, age doesn’t even matter, it’s the feelings in your heart, from what I see you guys have developed these feelings recently which means you are right not to start with the physical relations but a kiss, a small kiss won’t harm if you both like each other.” “So if it were you would will you have kissed her?” Drake asked, “After a while yes, of course if I liked her I would have.” “what about a second kiss” he asked, “Don’t rush your horses’ boy but yeah I will kiss her again too if the opportunity arises, but let’s stop it for me, me even saying it for reference makes it sounds weird, she’s like my sister, and I hope you care for her, you don’t want me on the wrong side.” Smith said with a normal tone, “Thanks a lot senpai, I will be contacting you again soon.

Drake did have quite experience with girls, but he had his weak spots, clever boys and girls, the one’s he believed in, he would never have judged them and thus he got caught in between both here. For he never thought the one he called her sister was hiding in the room with a recorder and she had recorded all of it, now all she had to do was edit it, yes, edit it to make it come out something like, “MARGO WHAT…. Yes…I like her…. of course I will kiss her again too if the opportunity arises.” And with that she went for plan 3.

“Smith will you meet me after school, I have something to talk to you. “Margo said to smith. “Sure girl I have to talk to you too” keeping in mind Drakes conversation he thought he should guide her too. Classes went on and at home time, he said to Margarrete I have something to do, you go ahead and so he went to Margo. He hid the truth from her in light that he didn’t wanted to let Margarette know just yet. She would get upset with her sister.

“So first tell me what was it you wanted to discuss” Smith said in an elderly brother voice.

“I wanted to tell you how much I hate you and that sick sister of mine together”

Smith was stunned. This was never what he could have thought of too…

“You see Smith, no grudge against you but I hate my sister, why? Because she over shadows me, everyone loves her, she gets all the good stuff and me I lose my individuality always. Luckily our parents have decided to send her abroad since she is such a bright student. Today she is to tell them her answer if she wants to go, and guess what she says, no, why? She does not want to leave you and I want her gone because if not we both go to the same high school and as I’m 2 years junior she will be in the final year when I join my first year and my debut will be labeled as Margarette’s cute little sister. Not as the awesome Margo who I always wanted to be.” I just want space.

“Such petty problems. They have such easy solutions” Smith said in a hurt voice,

“It’s too late “she replied and went off. Smith sat unable to believe what he was hearing. Margarette never mentioned abroad.
